_availabilityStatus: PARTIALLY SEEDED, 2026-08-04. `locations` is the per-location availability column. ONE row is real: carnitas, all seven, from live Toast menus. Every other row is still an empty array because THE SEVEN TOAST CATALOGS HAVE NOT BEEN SUPPLIED to this repo, only three findings from them were. Do not read an empty array as 'sold nowhere' or as 'sold everywhere'; it means unknown. Templates must not render per-location availability, and Menu schema must not be emitted per location, until this is filled. Known live-Toast findings not yet expressible here: East Village has a Sushi Hand Roll section (Open Decision #20, and no sushi item exists on this file to attach it to), and Maui labels every ramen item 'HM Noodles' (Open Decision #1, a noodle-provenance label rather than an availability fact).
